stem:
Chetan digs a small pit in the garden and examines the soil with a hand lens. He thinks about sand, insects, worms, tiny organisms, decayed plant and animal matter, and rocks broken by rainwater over time.

Which statement about soil is correct?

options.text: Soil and sand are the same material.
Soil forms immediately the first time rainwater cracks a rock.
Soil can contain sand, insects, worms, tiny organisms, and decayed plant and animal matter, and it forms over a long time as rocks break apart.
Soil never contains organisms too small to see with the naked eye.

teacher.key_rationale: Soil is more than sand. It forms slowly and can hold many organisms and decayed matter.
